title: Pet Of The Year Play-Off 2002
overview: Who will be the successor to the lovely Zdenka, POY 2001, and be crowned Penthouse Pet of the Year 2002? Well, we've captured these five incredibly sexy women for your to choose from. Nicole Marciano, Tera Patrick, Kyla Cole, Cristi Taylor, Megan Mason. Enjoy watching these sensuous beauties getting wild together, and be sure to cast your vote.
